title: MCP server
description: An MCP server, added as other harnesses add one (`claude mcp add`, `codex mcp add`): the command that starts it (stdio), or the address it listens at (http, sse). The values of its environment variables and headers are kept with the secrets, never in this file.

schema.title: Schema
schema.description: The kind and version this file is written in; always its first field.

title.description: The name clients show for this record; the file's own name when empty.
title.title: Title

transport.description: How Clank talks to it: stdio, a program started and spoken to over its input and output; http, the streamable HTTP transport; sse, the older server-sent events one.
transport.title: Transport

args.description: What the program is given after its name (stdio).
args.title: Arguments

env.description: The names of the environment variables it is started with; their values are secrets.
env.title: Environment

headers.description: The names of the HTTP headers sent to it; their values are secrets.
headers.title: Headers

local_only.description: What it gives the agent never goes to a cloud model (design 0016 §10): a workspace allowed the cloud does not get it, and the gateway keeps its tools and a session that used it from the cloud.
local_only.title: Local only
